args.subject: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail): PHL label confusion
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Pellow Home Living account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code moved from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the dropdowns when filing tickets.
- The Pemberline Dock export still showed the old Covey & Lark Retail header in February, which confused the receiving desk at one door.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The receiving supervisor has to search under both names. The report label needs changing to Pellow Home Living.
- Please use the full account name in subject lines, not PHL.

Thanks,
Sofia
